Subject: Intermittent 503s between 07:30-08:05 PT — tenant delta request

Hi Lauren / Marissa,

We're seeing an elevated rate of 503s for our production tenant between ~07:30 and 08:05 PT this morning. Our checkout failures spiked and we have a handful of customer incidents. Support attached a small telemetry bundle (clearpay_telemetry_20290528.zip) with Nai logs and sample request IDs.

Two asks from our side: 1) can Redwood confirm the exact service-unavailable window for ClearPay (tenant id CP-9a7) so we can reconcile our billing impact, and 2) confirm whether this qualifies for a proportional SLA remedy under our contract.

We're attaching symptomatic traces and sample request IDs in the bundle. Please let us know the next steps and who from Redwood will own the postmortem.

Thanks,
John
ClearPay — Ops

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, John Doe <john.doe@clearpay.com>
Date: Tue, 28 May 2029 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent 503s between 07:30-08:05 PT — tenant delta request

Marissa / team — initial findings below (holding summary for the postmortem):

Summary: between 07:28:53–08:03:41 PT we observed elevated 503 responses from the west-us inference cluster serving model xg-large-v1. The majority of impacted requests show a retriable backend error pattern tied to a transient KV cache eviction cascade on node pool gpu-a-5.

Key telemetry points:
- Request IDs flagged by ClearPay (CP-9a7): matched to our proxy logs and showed 503 responses at 2029-05-28T14:30:12Z, 2029-05-28T14:43:05Z, etc.
- Autoscaler: a scaling activity triggered at 07:26 PT due to a short throughput burst; new nodes joined but experienced delayed health probes for ~90s as the model warmup stalled (quantized model path).
- Preemption logs: one spot eviction (node gpu-a-5-12) at 07:31:18 PT aggravated cache warmups.
- Fallback/routing: Smart routing attempted regional fallback twice, but because ClearPay is pinned to west-us and tenant affinity was enforced, those fallback routes were not applied.

Impact window we can verify: 2029-05-28T07:28:53-07:33:11 PT (primary elevated 503 spike) and a smaller tail 07:40:20-08:03:41 PT (intermittent). I'm marking the conservative confirmed window for SLA purposes as 07:28:53-08:03:41 PT.

Preliminary remedy note: given the tenant affinity and that the issue was caused by a transient warmup + eviction event within our dedicated pool, this looks eligible for proportional remedy under the SLA (we apply prorated credit for the confirmed unavailable interval after adjusting for retries and mitigations). I'll produce a telemetry bundle and a short technical sequence-of-events for the RCA by tomorrow EOD.

I'll attach a trimmed trace bundle to the Jira ticket.

— Karthik
Engineering Lead, Serving Runtime

Attachment: rca_draft_v1.pdf (technical sequence), slo_runbook_snippet.txt

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: John Doe <john.doe@clearpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, support@clearpay.com
Date: Wed, 29 May 2029 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent 503s between 07:30-08:05 PT — tenant delta request

John — following Karthik's confirmation, here's the customer-facing summary and next steps: 

1) Confirmed incident window: 2029-05-28 07:28:53–08:03:41 PT (we used a conservative union of primary spike and tail).
2) Eligibility: preliminarily eligible for proportional SLA credit; final credit calculation will subtract any upstream retries or client-handled mitigations.
3) Deliverables and timing:
   - Telemetry bundle and formal RCA (engineering) — scheduled for 2029-05-30 17:00 PT.
   - Proforma credit calculation (finance + CS) — scheduled by 2029-05-31 12:00 PT.
   - Customer-facing postmortem draft for review — 2029-06-03.
4) Questions for ClearPay: do you want the provisional credit applied as an immediate invoice adjustment (frontloaded) or as a one-time credit on your next invoice? If frontloaded, finance will need a signed acknowledgment (we can provide a one-page credit memo).

We're keeping this open in INC-4721 (link below). I've cc'd support for routing the credit/AR flow. If you prefer a call to walk through the telemetry, we can set up a 30-minute slot tomorrow.

Thanks for flagging this — we'll prioritize the RCA and the credit calculation.

— Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales, Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference
